$comment: S01 Open-Meteo weather forecast (T010). Measure columns added to the common envelope (common.json). Field map: configs/sources/s01.yaml.

fields.name: cell_id
fields.meaning: om_<model>_<lat>N_<lon>E, the model grid point the API snapped to

fields.name: model
fields.meaning: The one named model requested, for example ecmwf_ifs025

fields.name: rain_mm
fields.meaning: precipitation over the preceding hour in mm

issued_at: last_run_initialisation_time from the model metadata, read before and after the forecast call
available_at: the later of last_run_availability_time + 10 minutes and the fetch time
missing: An hour with any measure missing becomes an all-null row with missing_reason out_of_coverage
